beats.narration_text: Let's recap with Claude. Letter cascade: each glyph springs in left to right — stagger delay is everything. Word slam: HUMANITARIANS lands heavy, then AI hits with a screen shake — the two-weight structure is the wordmark's whole argument. Draw-on glyphs: the outline traces then the fill floods, letter by letter. Baseline wave: sine pushing each letter up and down in sequence.

Your turn. Paste this: animate the HUMANITARIANS AI wordmark with a letter cascade — each glyph springs in left to right, staggered — then tell me the right stagger delay. Too fast and it reads as a pop. Too slow and it reads as a typing error.
H A I wordmark, in motion. Part one. Liam, in for Bear.
